partnerRequests.title: Partner requests
partnerRequests.subtitle: Withdrawals, loans and project offers sent from the investor portal · Admin approves · nobody approves their own
partnerRequests.noView: Partner requests need the partners right. Ask Admin.
partnerRequests.emptyBody: Requests arrive once partners sign in to the investor portal, or when Admin records one on a partner's behalf. Each card shows what the partner asked for beside what is due to them, with Approve, Change amount and Reject.
partnerRequests.payHint: Posts a payment: the partner's current account is debited and the bank credited. The server checks the account still covers it.
partnerRequests.recordLoan: Record the loan on Directors and investment →

decide.approveHint: The server checks what is due to the partner and the Companies Act rules before approving.
decide.loanHint: A loan to a partner needs the board resolution reference (and the CA's check) in the note. Loans to directors are restricted by Companies Act s.185; other loans are checked against the s.186 limit the CA records.
decide.rejectHint: Say why. The partner sees the reason in their portal.

submit.title: Record a request for a partner
submit.hint: For a partner who asked in person or in writing. Another Admin must decide it: nobody decides a request they recorded.
submit.question: Question

draw.title: What each partner can draw
draw.none: No partner recorded for this company.
draw.note: Balances come from the books (credit = the company owes the partner). Accounts are set on Partners and profit sharing.

checks.title: Checks before approving
checks.withdraw: Not more than the company owes the partner on their current account.
checks.loanTo: Loans to directors, and to firms or relatives they are interested in, have Companies Act limits. CA check and board approval first.
checks.loanFrom: A director's written declaration that the money is not borrowed; recorded in their loan account.
checks.project: Recorded as an offer; it becomes an investment only when Admin confirms it with the agreement.

after.title: After approval
after.one: The company pays from its bank; the entry posts to the bank and the partner's account.
after.two: The partner hears on WhatsApp (if they agreed to it), and the result shows in their portal.
after.three: Every request, approval and change of amount goes to the user log.
